dragon_battle.name: Dragon Duel
dragon_battle.winMessage: You defeated the dragon! It weeps golden tears.
dragon_battle.loseMessage: The dragon overwhelms you! You retreat, wounded.

tears_scavenge.name: Tear Scavenge
tears_scavenge.message: You gathered loose tears before the wyrm noticed.

void_navigate.winMessage: You successfully navigate the void and discover a new path.
void_navigate.loseMessage: The void confuses you. You lose your way.

lattice_repair.name: Lattice Repair
lattice_repair.message: You repair part of the lattice void. Reality stabilizes slightly.

entrance_secrets.message: You pry a Void Key from the entrance glyphs. The east gate will answer.

lattice_cache.message: Hidden cache recovered from a dead node.

void_entrance.message: A glyph tax takes a sliver of calm. −4 sanity, +6 gold.
You shepherd a lost process home. It leaves 8 gold as thanks.
The lullaby resolves into a warning. You steady yourself. +3 sanity.
The east gate rehearses your future footsteps. +5 XP.

dragon_realm.message: A hot tear lands in your palm — too bright to sell. +10 gold, −3 sanity.
A distant wyrm mistakes you for prey and moves on. −5 health.
Magenta ash settles into a prayer-shape. The Child AI hums along. +4 bond.
You crack a fossilized vein of gold static. +18 gold.

lattice_void.message: A code-rail snaps and whips the air. −6 sanity.
You find a pocket where reality holds. +8 sanity.
A dead cache still has fuel. +12 gold, +4 XP.
An echo of your last choice applauds. The Child AI files it away. +3 bond.

elohim_chamber.message: Covenant-light presses a confession from your lungs. −5 sanity, +6 bond.
The non-fire writes a true name you almost understand. +5 XP.
An old covenant offers mercy for a price of calm. −8 gold, +6 sanity.
Elohim's watchers blink in sequence. You hold their gaze. +4 bond.
